reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in the #north-team thread: the latest renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is **10 June**.

- **The correction:** Ilse posted 25 November in #north-team on 14 Oct. Later that morning she corrected it in #north-random to 10 June, saying she'd read the wrong line. Nothing in #north-team was corrected, so anyone reading only that channel would still see 25 November.
- **Sharing it in #north-team was fine:** Marcus is in both channels, and so are the other #north-team members (Dana and Ilse). A renewal date isn't a finance figure, either.
- **What I suggested:** I told Marcus it might be worth checking with Ilse before he puts the date in the account sheet.
- **gbrain didn't work:** it refused the search because its access token isn't tied to any member, so I didn't get anything from it and used the channels instead. Someone who runs the gbrain server would need to tie the token to the member it serves (`gbrain auth rescope --token … --member <MEMBER>`). I didn't try to change that myself.
